reason: Author-requested three-row diagram separates agent workflow, dynamic context selection, and engineering knowledge as a resource. The top workflow retains initial context before planning and places the Git precommit admission gate after implementation. The gate requires evidence of refined selection before commit is allowed.

validation.scope: Isolated one-figure production-pipeline proof; not a full-book render. Review-only candidate; existing publication decision is untouched.

fill: Only the shared engineering-knowledge resource container has light 5% gray. Its standing-instructions and repository boxes remain white, as do workflow and selection nodes. Enforcement is distinguished by a diamond gate rather than a color.
bold: Row labels are bold 9.5 pt with italic 9 pt role annotations. Node titles are bold 9.5–10 pt, with Implementation bold 9 pt. Scope/phase qualifiers and inventories are italic. Body text remains 9 pt; no text is scaled down.
routing: Workflow: initial agent context → planning → refined agent context → implementation → Git precommit gate → commit allowed. A dispatch hook provides initial selection from anticipated files/components; planning sends a dashed refined-scope edge to the second selection, which uses refined files/dependencies and may add or remove context. Each selection feeds its corresponding context. The same engineering-knowledge repository feeds both selections. Standing instructions remain explicitly available throughout. No lifecycle return edge exists.
shape: Rounded rectangles represent context, work and selection stages. A diamond distinguishes the Git precommit admission decision. The subtle gray resource container holds repository and standing-instruction boxes.
visual_review: Both native and live-text SVG proofs inspected at print size and 2×. Three left-hand row labels organize the workflow, context-selection mechanisms, and resource container. The admission gate is a diamond after implementation, with Commit allowed as its output. Gate text remains at 9–10 pt without scaling; the taller diamond fits in otherwise empty space. The refined-context box was widened slightly to retain label padding. No caption or figure number is embedded, and no flow implies that the precommit gate precedes implementation.
